LESSON: POOL SAFETY SWIMMING

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.1: Pool safety SWIMMING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Pool safety SWIMMING. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify basic water safety and hygiene in the safety and hygiene rules pool for application in the • Encourage
2. demonstrate ability to accordingly follow safety rules accordingly Core-Competence • Learning to learn

Example 1: Talk about Pool safety SWIMMING using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Pool safety SWIMMING in the examples.
2. Explain Pool safety SWIMMING to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Pool safety SWIMMING.
4. Show that you can: identify basic water safety and hygiene in the safety and hygiene rules pool for application in the • Encourage

2. Answer: Why is Pool safety SWIMMING important for a PP2 learner?
